summary: Iter-265 SSOT Product Trust Gate validation. All 8 unit tests in test_qoyod_ssot_product_trust_gate.py PASS. Full Qoyod regression suite is GREEN (487 baseline + 4 new HTTP smoke = 491 passed, 2 skipped). Frontend QYD-GO page loads without console errors and the diagnostics button is functional. Found and fixed ONE P0 bug while running HTTP-level tests: the new POST /api/integrations/qoyod/products/adopt endpoint was raising NameError because routes.py referenced adopt_qoyod_product without importing it — added the missing import. Dead-letter auto-requeue regression (iter-264) verified still working.

minor.issue: FIXED by test agent — routes.py was missing 'from integrations.qoyod.product_resolver import adopt_qoyod_product', causing every adoption call to 500 with NameError. Trivial one-line import fix applied at routes.py:30. Main agent should confirm this is the right module path and review whether other resolver helpers (e.g. resolve_products) should also be imported into routes for consistency.

action_items: Review the import fix at /app/backend/integrations/qoyod/routes.py:30 — 'from integrations.qoyod.product_resolver import adopt_qoyod_product'. Without it the adoption endpoint cannot work in production. Recommend adding a lint rule or one-line unit test that calls attach_qoyod_routes() and POSTs to /products/adopt to prevent this regression.

Optional: live verification of the name_ar display fallback requires a tenant whose Qoyod account contains products with only name_ar (e.g. 'اقمشة متنوعة'). The admin@hesab.app tenant on preview has only a test API key (08cef...) that returns 401 against legacy.qoyod.com, so the diagnostics sample is empty. Static code review confirms QoyodGoLive.jsx:365-380 implements the documented fallback chain (p.name || p.name_ar || p.name_en → '(بدون اسم)') and renders the name_source badge.
critical_code_review_comments: P0 (already fixed): routes.py used adopt_qoyod_product without importing it — only caught via runtime HTTP test, not pytest. The 8 unit tests imported the function directly from product_resolver so they could never have caught this. Consider adding a test that exercises every new route via TestClient before claiming a feature is complete.

DryRunQoyodClient.find_product_by_sku returns None — good for dev — but the dry-run path now never exercises the qoyod_existing_untrusted code branch end-to-end. Consider a feature-flagged dry-run scenario that simulates a legacy hit.
The trust-gate error payload puts qoyod_product_id as a string ('1') from a Qoyod-returned int (1). Confirm the dead-letter audit UI expects a string here for stable equality checks.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (QYD-GO renders, diagnostics button functional, no console errors)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 SSOT trust-gate unit tests + 4 new HTTP smoke tests pass. The one bug found (missing import in routes.py) was fixed by this testing agent. The full Qoyod regression (test_qoyod_*.py) shows 491 passed / 2 skipped. To rerun: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_qoyod_*.py -q. For HTTP: tests/test_qoyod_ssot_trust_gate_http_iter265.py uses admin login on preview URL. Frontend verification of the name_ar fallback chain is NOT exercisable end-to-end without a real Qoyod tenant; QoyodGoLive.jsx:365-380 contains the correct fallback (p.name||p.name_ar||p.name_en → '(بدون اسم)' with name_source badge).
rca of the issue: P0 — NameError on POST /products/adopt. Root cause: routes.py:712 called adopt_qoyod_product() but the symbol was never imported into the module. The 8 new unit tests imported adopt_qoyod_product directly from integrations.qoyod.product_resolver, so they could not catch the routing-layer omission. Reproduction: with the unfixed code, send POST /api/integrations/qoyod/products/adopt with valid body — server returns 500 + traceback 'NameError: name adopt_qoyod_product is not defined'. Mitigation applied: added 'from integrations.qoyod.product_resolver import adopt_qoyod_product' at routes.py line 30. Re-verified by HTTP smoke test which now passes.
